description: On the table in front of you are two bowls: a light blue bowl with a round pink disc-like item sitting on top of other small items, and an orange bowl with a small rectangular piece inside. The left hand stays near the table while the right hand reaches forward to the blue bowl, pinches and lifts the pink disc as a right-hand object, carries it rightward over to the orange bowl, then lowers and releases it into the orange bowl.
